name: playsync
description: Multi-device playback coordination as a concurrency-control lab (MySQL/InnoDB).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec mysql mysql -uroot -proot playsync
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
